name: 55120 · Mendota Hts, MN
findings: ZIP 55120 (Mendota Hts) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55120 (Mendota Hts) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
